A '''protoplanetary disk''' surrounded the [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kuna's Eye/Legends|Kuna's Eye]] in the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye system]], within the [[Inner Zuma Region|Inner Zuma]] Region of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Its parent [[Star system/Legends|system]] was less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane, located inside the [[thin disk]]. The [[Planet/Legends|protoplanetary]] disk was rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], metals, and alloys, and [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] were frequently sighted in the system. Their needs were served by the [[Mote]], a cobbled-together [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] at the edge of the disk.

==Description==
Located in the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]],<ref name="teaoc" /> within the [[Inner Zuma Region|Inner Zuma]] Region at [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] coordinates H-16, a [[Planet/Legends|protoplanetary]] disk surrounded the [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kuna's Eye/Legends|Kuna's Eye]]. The disk's parent [[Star system/Legends|system]] was less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] above the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane, which made it a part of the [[thin disk]], the tract of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] whose vertical distance from the plane was not more than 1,000 light-[[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The protoplanetary disk was rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]],<ref name="TEA" /> metals, and alloys.<ref name="gamer9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

==History==
As of the year [[43 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the protoplanetary disk had not condensed into planets. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Kuna's Eye was also relatively young, which made the system a fairly typical [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]].<ref name="gamer9" /> The Kuna's Eye system was also frequented by [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]], and a cobbled-together [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called the [[Mote]] was built to serve their needs.<ref name="gamer9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first mention of the protoplanetary disk came from the article ''[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]'', authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Jason Fry]], and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine, released on [[March 1]], [[2002]].<ref name="gamer9" /> The disk was also mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> a reference book written by Wallace and Fry released on [[August 18]], [[2009]].<ref name="teaoc" />
